items.title: Ruby 2D 1.0: SDL3, WebAssembly, and a Comeback Story
items.blurb: Make 2D applications with Ruby. Ruby 2D is a library for creating 2D applications, games, graphics, and interactive art in a way that's simple, natural, and joyful, in the spirit of Ruby itself.

items.title: Learn how to use its DSL here
items.blurb: Write Ruby 2D code and run it right in your browser. No install required.

items.title: Tom's story of resurrecting the project
items.blurb: A ground-up rewrite more than a decade in the making, and the story of how it very nearly didn't happen at all.

items.title: 🚨 We Audited 137 Rails Apps. 98% Had a Critical KEV
items.blurb: A read-only assessment of your images, clusters, runtimes, databases, and pipelines. Prioritized findings and a 30-60-90 day plan in four to six weeks.

items.title: Rails is done
items.blurb: The core of Rails has stood the tests of time. To this day, it is a great way to build web applications. But DHH’s view of the world is fundamentally incompatible with mine, and I’m not the only one who feels that way.
